sql: WITH stores_both_years AS (SELECT DISTINCT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2008 INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009), sales_2008 AS (SELECT sum(SalesAmount) as sales FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2008 AND StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM stores_both_years)), sales_2009 AS (SELECT sum(SalesAmount) as sales FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM stores_both_years)) SELECT s9.sales as sales_2009, s8.sales as sales_2008, round((s9.sales - s8.sales) * 100.0 / s8.sales, 2) as growth_pct FROM sales_2009 s9, sales_2008 s8
